name: better-t-stack
description: Let your AI scaffold and extend projects with Better-T-Stack. Bundles the create-better-tanstacked MCP server plus skills so the assistant plans a valid stack and generates it instead of hand-rolling boilerplate.

interface.longDescription: Build TanStack React apps with Better-T-Stack. Skills plan and generate TanStack Router or TanStack Start projects, or add tooling to an existing Better-T-Stack project through the official MCP server. Supports Hono, Elysia, TanStack Start server routes, databases, auth, APIs, and deployment options.
defaultPrompt: Create a fullstack TanStack Start app with Hono, Postgres + Drizzle, and Better Auth
Scaffold a TanStack Start project with a Neon database
Add PWA, Oxlint, and Turborepo to my Better-T-Stack project
